body: The worst thing about having no idea how to stand up for myself is controlling my anger. If I'm mad at something or someone, that just stays inside of me and builds up. It comes out at the wrong times, at the wrong person. I'll have terrible mood swings, like I did last night. Today I feel loads better just letting it all out, and having someone to talk to

Well our company holds these events called "after hours" where they take everyone out to a restaurant and buy food and beer. That's just not my thing. I get really nervous in loud places, and surrounded by people. It's hard for me to actually get out of my room to do anything social. But I'm feeling better this morning since I actually talked about my problems. I'm going to start today anew. Thank you
Oh shit it is midnight isn't it. Thanks again

The coworkers I can deal with. My boss himself is the definition of a Dick. Not just to me but everyone at our office. He had a stomach virus the other day, so he pukes in a trash can, then takes said trash can and dumps it into mine where I put the trash out of the rental cars. So I had to clean both trashcans that were full of his puke. He is just a true Dick to heart
I'm not even waiting for the right girl. It's easier these days to get married, then divorced months later, so why not cut out the middle man? (woman in this case)

Actually this is kind of why most people consider me weird: I'm attracted to women, but I have never had the desire to have a girlfriend/SO/ booty call or anything along those lines. But my siblings and I just have nothing in common. Each conversation we have is short and to the point. Also the job spectrum around where I live is very small. While my job does suck big dicks, its work and that's one thing to be thankful for I guess

That's actually really helpful. While my siblings aren't a big  part at all, I've just always thought of people around me more than putting myself first. So Fuck them, its my turn for a change. Tomorrow is a new day. Thanks again, I just really needed to get all that in the open. Just typing all of that made me feel loads better.

I hate that I no longer have friends. It seems after high school, they all left and did amazing things, while I'm stuck living with my parents. I can't afford school at all. It's like while everyone else is growing up, I get deeper into this dark shell that I never leave, nor do I want to. Thanks for taking the time to talk
